zh.title: 買洗車機，不只是買設備！ShinoX 原廠技術交流與開店輔導一次到位
zh.tagline: 一台洗車機，是事業的開始；完整的技術與營運支援，才是長期經營的關鍵。
intro: 購買洗車機之後，最重要的是什麼？
除了設備品質，業者更需要了解設備如何維護、遇到問題如何處理，以及如何把洗車場真正經營起來。
ShinoX 希望提供的不只是一台洗車機，而是一套從設備導入、開店準備到日常營運的支援服務。
zh.communityTagline: 購買設備後，技術交流不中斷。
communityIntro: 凡購買符合方案的 ShinoX 洗車機，即可獲得原廠技術交流群組的加入資格。
透過交流群組，設備業者可與原廠團隊分享使用經驗，了解設備操作、日常保養及常見維護問題。
即使設備超過保固期間，也能持續透過群組交流維修與保養知識，逐步建立自主維護能力。
points: 零組件維護及更換知識
保固期後的維修保養經驗分享
zh.communityNote: 技術交流不另外收取群組參與費用；實際維修、零件、到場服務及保固範圍依購買合約與服務條件辦理。
zh.guideTagline: 從規劃到開店，再到日常營運，一本掌握。
guideIntro: 買了設備，接下來該怎麼開店？
ShinoX 提供開店輔導手冊，協助創業者建立完整的洗車場經營觀念。
不論是第一次投入洗車產業，還是準備擴展第二間、第三間門市，都能透過手冊掌握各階段需要注意的工作。
guides: 創業規劃
投資預算、開店模式與成本評估
場地評估
位置選擇、車流動線與空間配置
建場施工
洗車格規劃、水電、排水及設備安裝
設備選擇
洗車機型、周邊設備與功能搭配
開店準備
營業流程、收費方式及開幕安排
行銷推廣
廣告宣傳、會員經營與回流策略
營運管理
日常巡檢、成本控制與營收管理
法規須知
土地使用、建築、排水及其他應確認事項
zh.guideClosing: 讓業者在不同經營階段，都有實用的參考資料可以查閱。
zh.guideNote: 法規內容為一般性資訊，實際申請與合法性仍應依所在地主管機關及專業人員確認。
zh.serviceTitle: 03｜從硬體設備，到長期營運支援
zh.serviceTagline: 我們重視設備交付，更重視設備交付後的經營需求。
serviceIntro: ShinoX 的產品服務不只停留在設備銷售。
我們希望透過技術交流、維護知識及開店輔導資料，協助客戶在設備投入營運後，仍能持續獲得所需要的資訊。
zh.serviceClosing: 讓每一次設備採購，不只是完成一筆交易，而是為長期經營建立更完整的基礎。
zh.closingTitle: ShinoX｜不只提供洗車設備，更提供經營的後盾。
zh.closing: 無論你正在規劃第一間自助洗車場，或準備升級現有設備，ShinoX 都歡迎與你討論適合的配置與經營方向。
zh.ctaIntro: 從設備選擇到開店規劃，歡迎聯絡 ShinoX。
zh.note: 註：技術交流群組與開店手冊之提供方式，以實際購買方案及合約內容為準。群組交流屬知識分享，非不限次數免費維修承諾；法規與營運資訊亦不構成獲利或核准保證。

en.title: More Than a Car Wash Machine — ShinoX Technical Support & Business Guidance
en.tagline: A car wash machine is the start of a business. Comprehensive technical and operational support is what helps sustain it over time.
intro: What matters most after purchasing a car wash machine?
Beyond equipment quality, operators need to understand how to maintain their equipment, respond to problems and run a car wash business in practice.
ShinoX aims to offer more than a machine: a support service covering equipment introduction, opening preparations and day-to-day operations.
en.communityTagline: Technical exchange continues after your equipment purchase.
communityIntro: Purchasers of ShinoX car wash machines under eligible plans can join the ShinoX technical support community.
Through the community, equipment operators can share their experiences with the ShinoX technical team and learn about equipment operation, routine care and common maintenance issues.
Even after the equipment warranty has expired, members can continue exchanging repair and maintenance knowledge through the group, gradually developing their own maintenance capabilities.
points: Equipment operation and practical usage tips
Repair and maintenance experience beyond the warranty period
en.communityNote: There is no additional group participation fee for technical exchange. Repairs, parts, on-site service and warranty coverage are subject to the purchase agreement and service terms.
en.guideTitle: 02 | A Dedicated Car Wash Business Guide
en.guideTagline: From planning and opening to daily operations, in one practical guide.
guideIntro: You have purchased the equipment. How do you get your business open?
ShinoX provides a business guide to help entrepreneurs build a comprehensive understanding of car wash operations.
Whether you are entering the car wash industry for the first time or preparing to expand to a second or third location, the guide outlines the work to consider at each stage.
en.guideLabel: The guide covers eight key topics:
guides: Business planning
Investment budgeting, business models and cost assessment
Site assessment
Location selection, vehicle circulation and space planning
Site construction
Wash-bay planning, utilities, drainage and equipment installation
Equipment selection
Car wash models, ancillary equipment and function combinations
Opening preparations
Operating procedures, pricing methods and opening arrangements
Marketing
Advertising, membership development and customer retention
Operations management
Routine inspections, cost control and revenue management
Regulatory considerations
Land use, buildings, drainage and other matters requiring verification
en.guideClosing: This gives operators practical reference material to consult at different stages of their business.
en.guideNote: Regulatory content is general information. Applications and legal compliance must be confirmed with the relevant local authorities and qualified professionals.
en.serviceTitle: 03 | From Hardware to Long-Term Operational Support
en.serviceTagline: We care about equipment delivery—and the operational needs that follow.
serviceIntro: ShinoX’s product services do not end with equipment sales.
Through technical exchange, maintenance knowledge and business guidance materials, we aim to help customers continue accessing the information they need after their equipment enters service.
en.serviceClosing: Each equipment purchase can then be more than a transaction: it can establish a more comprehensive foundation for long-term operation.
en.closingTitle: ShinoX | More than car wash equipment. Support for your business.
en.closing: Whether you are planning your first self-service car wash or upgrading existing equipment, ShinoX welcomes a discussion about suitable configurations and your business direction.
en.ctaIntro: From equipment selection to opening plans, contact ShinoX to discuss your needs.
en.note: Note: Access to the technical support community and business guide is subject to the applicable purchase plan and agreement. Group exchange is knowledge sharing, not a commitment to unlimited free repairs. Regulatory and operational information does not constitute a guarantee of profit or approval.
